{{Quote|A deployable overreaction. The governing council of Salline had protested the seizure of its citizens by the ISB secret police. The Imperial governor branded them traitors. This was the result.|Mon Mothma's annotation on a copy of the ''Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide'', regarding the Pacification of Salline.|<ref name="Imperial Handbook" />}}
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]],<ref name="Imperial Handbook" /> this '''Imperial Governor''' governed the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]].<ref name="Imperial Handbook" /> According to [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] founder<ref name="TFUN">[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed (novelization)|''Star Wars: The Force Unleashed'' novelization]]</ref> [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]], the governor declared the [[Governing council of Salline]] to be traitors after they protested the seizure of its citizens by the [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]]. This lead to [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces under the command of [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Maximilian Veers/Legends|Maximilian Veers]] to be dispatched to root out the opposition.<ref name="Imperial Handbook" />
